<div class="card-body">
'''Organa's Ceremonial Necklace''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].







<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">オーガナ家の式典用ネックレス</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のヤヴィン４の位置カードに配備する。帝国軍カードを１つ対象に選ぶ。このカードと同じ位置に着けば、ネックレスを“盗んだ”ことになる。以後、ネックレスがある位置では、フォース消耗を＋１できる。さらに、隣接している位置カードを支配していれば、そこへコストなしで移動させ、フォース消耗に＋１できる。以降、繰り返し。</span>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">レイア姫がヤヴィンの戦勝祝典でつけていたネックレス。オルデランの統治者に何十世代も伝わる力を秘めた工芸品。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The Organa family's ceremonial necklace.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any Yavin 4 location card. Choose an Imperial card as the target. When it reaches the same location as this card, the necklace is ‘stolen.’ Thereafter, at the location where the necklace is, you may add 1 to the Force drain. In addition, if you control an adjacent location card, you may move it there at no cost and add 1 to the Force drain. Repeat thereafter.

'''Lore:''' The necklace Princess Leia wore at the Yavin victory celebration. A crafted object with hidden power, passed down among Alderaan's rulers for dozens of generations.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a Yavin 4 location card and an Imperial card; the English specifies a Yavin 4 site and targets an Imperial. The Japanese says the drain may be increased at the necklace's location and describes moving it to an adjacent controlled location; the English describes passing it to an adjacent controlled site during Force drains.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Organa's Ceremonial Necklace]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97.
